description: eCash Transaction Recovery - Durable, resumable transaction system for all eCash transfer flows to ensure no funds are lost when the app crashes mid-flight

userStories.title: Create tx-recovery.ts module with types and storage
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a dedicated recovery module with transaction state types and storage functions to persist transaction state across app reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/model/cashu/tx-recovery.ts file
Define TxType type: 'nutszap' | 'nutszap-melt' | 'zap'
Define TxState interface with txId, type, createdAt, updatedAt, step, params, proofs, quotes, nostr, and errors fields
Define transaction step constants for all three flows
Implement saveTxState(txId, state) to persist to IndexedDB
Implement loadTxState(txId) to retrieve from IndexedDB
Implement deleteTxState(txId) to clean up completed transactions
Implement listPendingTransactions() to get all non-finalized txs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Foundation story - all other recovery features depend on this

userStories.title: Add proof reservation to NutsWallet with persistence
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to reserve proofs before using them in transactions to prevent double-spend during crashes and recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Add reservedProofs: Map<string, Proof[]> to NutsWallet class
Add reserveProofs(mint, proofs) method - moves from unspent to reserved
Add releaseReserved(mint, proofs) method - moves reserved back to unspent
Add commitReserved(mint, proofs) method - moves reserved to spent
Persist reserved proofs to localStorage (key format: 'reserved_[pubkey]_[mint]')
Load reserved proofs from localStorage on wallet initialization
Update balance calculation to exclude reserved proofs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Required before implementing state machine steps that reserve proofs

userStories.title: Implement startTransaction and core state machine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to start transactions and advance through steps with idempotent retry logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement startTransaction(type, params) in tx-recovery.ts
Generate unique txId using timestamp + random
Create initial TxState with step='init'
Store activeTxId in localStorage via persistentWritable
Implement advanceTransaction(txId) that loads state and runs next step
Each step updates state.step and persists before/after execution
Implement finalizeTransaction(txId) to clear activeTxId and mark complete
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Core recovery logic that all transaction types will use

userStories.title: Implement Nutszap (same-mint) state machine steps
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Nutszap flow state machine for same-mint P2PK sends.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement 'reserve_proofs' step: reserve proofs from wallet
Implement 'build_nutszap_event' step: create and sign kind 9321 event
Implement 'publish_nutszap_event' step: publish via usePublish, store first relay ack
Implement 'finalize' step: commit reserved proofs, clear activeTxId
Each step checks if already completed and skips idempotently
Errors are stored in state.errors with step context
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Covers the simplest transaction type first

userStories.title: Implement Nutszap+Melt (mint swap) state machine steps
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Nutszap+Melt flow state machine for cross-mint transfers.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement 'get_melt_quote' step: request melt quote from source mint
Implement 'perform_melt' step: execute melt, store change proofs
Implement 'get_mint_quote' step: request mint quote from target mint
Implement 'perform_mint' step: poll for paid status, mint new proofs
Integrate with existing steps: reserve_proofs, build_nutszap_event, publish_nutszap_event, finalize
Store meltQuote and mintQuote in state.quotes for idempotency
Store minted proofs in state.proofs.minted
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Builds on US-004 steps, adds cross-mint swap logic

userStories.title: Implement Zap (Lightning) state machine steps
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Zap flow state machine for Lightning payments.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement 'build_zap_request' step: create kind 9734 zap request
Implement 'fetch_zap_invoice' step: get invoice from LNURL callback
Implement 'get_melt_quote' step: create melt quote for zap invoice
Implement 'perform_melt' step: pay the invoice, store change
Implement 'store_change_proofs' step: save change to wallet
Implement 'finalize' step: commit reserved, clear activeTxId
Store zap invoice in state for idempotency
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Lightning flow uses different steps than Nutszap flows

userStories.title: Implement force cancel transaction
userStories.description: As a user, I want to force cancel a stuck transaction and recover my reserved funds.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement abortTransaction(txId) in tx-recovery.ts
Release reserved proofs back to wallet
Preserve transaction state in IndexedDB for audit (do not delete)
Clear activeTxId from localStorage
Mark transaction as aborted with timestamp
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Safety feature for users when recovery gets stuck

userStories.title: Add global resume on app startup
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to automatically resume any pending transaction when it starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create resumeActiveTransaction() function in tx-recovery.ts
Load activeTxId from persistentWritable store
Load TxState from storage
If step !== 'finalize', call advanceTransaction(txId)
Add resume call to src/routes/+layout.svelte onMount
Resume should be non-blocking (don't await forever)
Log resume attempts and outcomes to console
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Integrate recovery system into ecash.svelte
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to wire the recovery system into the existing ecash modal.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace direct sendEcash logic with startTransaction() calls
For same-mint Nutszap: call startTransaction('nutszap', params)
For cross-mint Nutszap: call startTransaction('nutszap-melt', params)
For Zap: call startTransaction('zap', params)
Subscribe to transaction state for UI progress updates
Show 'Resuming transaction...' banner when recovery is active
Display current step and last error if any
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: UI integration - replaces existing inline flow logic

userStories.title: Handle edge cases and error recovery
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to handle edge cases like quote expiry and mint unavailability.
acceptanceCriteria: In perform_melt: if quote expired, abort and release proofs
In perform_mint: if quote expired, abort and release proofs
In fetch_zap_invoice: if fails, abort and release proofs
Add retry with exponential backoff for network failures (max 3 retries)
If mint returns error, abort transaction and restore funds
All errors are stored in state.errors for debugging
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Robustness - ensures funds are never lost even in error conditions
